top_signals.title: Goldman’s Moe Sees 80% Upside for Korean Stocks on Memory Boom
top_signals.summary: A Goldman Sachs Group Inc. strategist is standing by his bullish target for South Korean stocks, saying investors underestimate how long the AI boost for the nation’s memory chipmakers will last.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
